notes.title: The update that's NOT an update!
notes.content:
New in this version (1.0.215)


ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!!!!!!

As I was about to release [b]Don Flatus: Poop Hunter[/b] back in November 2020, the programming language used to make the game had a massive update. It caused all sorts of glitches, crashes and problems so I have been using an outdated version of the language since the games release.....

Until now!

All the issues caused by the language update have been dealt with (I hope!). So this version should be [i]exactly[/i] the same as 1.0.214 (still hoping!)

If you are seeing anything that is different or are getting any bugs, please get in touch

Thanks for your time,
Scott A. Cooke
Creator of Don Flatus: Poop Hunter
